about:
Steel Technologies LLC is headquartered in Louisville, Kentucky. The company was founded in 1971 by Merwin J. Ray, with its first plant in Eminence, Kentucky. After trading on NASDAQ for 22 years, it became a wholly owned subsidiary of Mitsui & Co. (USA), Inc. in 2007. In 2010, Mitsui formed a joint venture with Nucor Corporation, known as NuMit, which now owns 100% of the company. Steel Technologies operates as an independent business under this ownership.

The company processes steel and aluminum across 32 locations in North America, shipping over 3.8 million tons annually to more than 2,500 customer ship-to locations worldwide, with annual sales exceeding $2.5 billion. Its value-added processing includes pre-painted and specialty coated steel up to 0.625 inches thick, high-heat products, and cold metal products. Capabilities extend to supply chain management, logistics, vendor-managed inventory, and technical support, all accessible through a 24/7 customer portal.

Steel Technologies serves the automotive industry, supplying all automotive grades and leading in exposed blanking for U.S. automakers. Its customer base includes industrial manufacturers across North America, such as Calstrip Industries in Mira Loma, California. The company’s strategically located facilities near railways, waterways, and airports provide cost-saving logistics advantages.

The company emphasizes a customer-driven, growth-oriented culture, citing its dedicated team, extensive capabilities, and broad geographic reach as key differentiators. An unwavering standard of quality and excellence guides its material processing, while its supply chain services aim to deliver cost savings and reliability.
